{"narrative": "I have a loan that meets the requirements for a HARP refinance and Wells Fargo currently holds that loan. I have attempted over the past year to process a HARP refinance however Wells Fargo keeps coming up with different reasons why they can not process it. The first was that there were lates on my account and after many many many phone calls to resolve the fact that I had no lates I was told that was not the reason and that the reason is now because I have lender paid mortgage insurance. Under the HARP program a refinance with Lender Paid Mortgage Insurance is allowable and Well Fargo stated that as well but say they wont do the refinance because of it. For a program meaning HARP that is supposed to simplify the process for eligible borrowers Wells Fargo has made this a miserable impossible experience."}

{"narrative": "I am filing a complaint against LVNV Funding LLC for illegally re-aging and re-inserting an old, time-barred debt onto my credit report. 

This debt originally became delinquent in XXXX. It was removed from my credit report 12 years ago due to age, which means the credit bureaus purged it under the XXXX reporting limit. LVNV recently reinserted the account on my credit report in XX/XX/year> without providing the legally required XXXX written notice of reinsertion. 

LVNV is in violation of : * * FCRA 605 ( a ) * * reporting derogatory information older than 7 years * * FCRA 623 ( a ) ( 5 ) * * altering the Date of First Delinquency ( illegal re-aging ) * * FCRA 611 * * reinserting previously deleted information without notice * * FDCPA 807 * * misrepresenting the legal status of a debt * * FDCPA 813 * * causing direct damages I never acknowledged this debt, never made a payment, and never restarted the statute of limitations. LVNV has been emailing me settlement offers for years, which demonstrates they knew the debt was time-barred. Despite this, they reinserted the account and reported a new delinquency date to make it appear recent. 

This caused an immediate XXXX drop in my credit score overnight. 

I am requesting that the CFPB require LVNV to : 1. Provide the * * original Date of First Delinquency * * 2. Provide documentation supporting their right to report this account 3. Remove the illegal tradeline from all credit bureaus 4. Provide a written explanation of why reinsertion occurred without notice Please take enforcement action as appropriate. This reinsertion and re-aging appear intentional and deceptive."}

{"narrative": "Sallie Mae withdrew an automatic payment on XX/XX/year> after I had contacted them in XXXX because I received an email stating repayment was restarting. During that call, I was told repayment would not resume because I would be returning to school in the XXXX semester and was already planning academic enrollment. I relied on that information. 

My deferment ended in XXXX because the XXXX XXXX XXXX only verifies current enrollment, not future enrollment. However, since I contacted Sallie Mae ahead of the deferment ending and confirmed my spring enrollment, I should have been placed in administrative forbearance or pending enrollment statusnot full repayment with autopay active. 

The unexpected withdrawal overdrafted my bank account and caused financial harm. When I requested a refund, Sallie Mae stated that reversing the payment would mark my account as delinquent, and they refused to acknowledge the misinformation I relied on from XXXX or the lapse between deferment expiration and enrollment reporting. 

I acted responsibly and in good faith. The repayment was triggered due to a processing gap and misinformationnot borrower neglect. 

Call log : Date : XX/XX/year> Time : XXXX Agent ( s ) : XXXX ( M ) and XXXX ( F ) Summary : - Servicer claimed repayment was correct despite prior verbal guidance. 
- Denied responsibility for miscommunication.

I am demanding a full investigation and the immediate removal of this account from all credit reports due to these violations and failure to follow lawful procedures. 
Account XXXX Exeter finance llc"}

{"narrative": "XXXX XXXX advertised a partnership with Sage Home Loans, offering Exclusive loan offer : Get an exclusive mortgage loan offer on a new home purchase or refinance home loan thats up to 0.75 % lower than average with no asset minimum required. alongside a {$500.00} closing credit. 

The loan scenario it outlined is XXXX fixed rate, {$500000.00} loan amount, Primary residence, Detached single family home, XXXX score XXXX, XXXX 75 % XXXX no other agency LLPAs. 

Now, I worked in mortgage pricing previously, so I understand how pricing works. Given it mentioned either purchase or refinance as purpose, the XXXX in my case ( refinance ) would be 0.125 % in their scenario. My loan scenario, a refinance with all the same attributes but a XXXX loan amount and a 69 % XXXX has no XXXX XXXX LLPAs. 

Given the LLPAs on my loan should make the rate 0.125 % better and the only difference is a slightly lower loan amount ( more desirable from a pricing perspective ), I expected that the price I would receive would be the same as the offer if not better. However, I was given a quote that was XXXX points worse. This feels against the spirit of what the offer should be and very misleading. 

I called the company to see if it might be a mistake and I was told that because I didnt have the exact scenario, I wouldnt get the 0.75 % better rate but I did still get {$2000.00} off. That is a significantly different offer!! The company should not be allowed to advertise like this when the spirit of the offer is completely different the minute you dont have the exact advertised loan scenario. For me this was really frustrating, but for someone who doesnt understand the intricacies of mortgage pricing, they are basically being deceived by the offer. 

In fact, I was so upset that I cancelled XXXX XXXX, which I had signed up for to take advantage of this offer."}

{"narrative": "To Whom It May Concern, I am writing to formally dispute certain information on my credit report that I believe is inaccurate and was reported without my authorization or consent. Specifically, I am referencing the entry listed under the account number [ insert account number or description of item you dispute ] in my credit report.

According to 15 U.S.C. 1681b, a credit reporting agency may only furnish consumer information to third parties with the consumer 's written consent or when otherwise permissible under the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ). I do not recall ever providing written consent, either directly or indirectly, for the reporting of my information to your bureau or the furnishing of my information to any third party.

In addition, under 15 U.S.C. 1681e ( b ), it is required that credit bureaus maintain and ensure the accuracy of all information reported. Since I have not authorized the reporting of this account, I request that you immediately investigate this entry to determine its origin and accuracy, and provide documentation to confirm that my written consent was obtained prior to reporting my information. 
Please investigate this matter in accordance with FCRA regulations and provide me with the results of your findings. Should you fail to provide the necessary documentation or if you are unable to verify the accuracy of this information, I request that you remove the disputed entry from my credit report.

In compliance with the FCRA, I expect a response within the legally mandated 30-day period from the receipt of this letter."}

XXXX XXXX, XXXX."}
